messages:
Anita Chen: Vendor update — HyperGate pushed ETA for batch HG-42 (48x H200) from 2026-04-10 to 2026-04-18. Customs hold in FRA for HS reclassification. See AWB 3344556677.
VendorOpsBot: shipment_update: AWB 3344556677 status=customs_hold location=FRA reason=hs_reclass
Marco Ruiz: Do we have warm spares cross-dockable in AMS or LHR? We need to keep Dedicated SLO for eu-west-1.
HyperGate_Rep: Hey team — sorry, we hit an HS code audit. We can release a subset (12 units) for immediate air if you accept partial claim + expedite fee EUR 8k per AWB.
Shawn Patel: 8k/air each? that's > our expedite budget. what's lead time on alternate warm spares from our staging pools?
Lina Gomez: Staging pool report:
```
region: eu-west-1: available_warm_spares=4
region: eu-west-2: available_warm_spares=6
region: us-east-1: available_warm_spares=2
```
Anita Chen: So total 12 available but split across regions with 2 in us-east. Cross-dock + transit to FRA takes 36-48h from LHR/AMS.
Shawn Patel: If we move 6 from eu-west-2 to eu-west-1, network capacity on the peering link is the limiter — current peak egress 6.2 Gbps, schedule transfer off-peak.
Marco Ruiz: Also note cluster thermal headroom in eu-west-1 is limited — can't accept >24 added GPUs without staggered rollouts. Ops: @Lina can you create a stagger plan?
Lina Gomez: On it. Draft plan: stagger 6/6 over 8 hours, validate temp/PSU metrics; rollback window 30m.
HyperGate_Rep: If you go for partial release, we'll send provisional RMA docs. We need you to sign partial-acceptance PDF and confirm payment for expedite within 4h.
Anita Chen: We won't sign blind. Need consolidated cost: expedite fee + customs broker + crossdock + transit. Also want vendor to cover DOA replacements for this wave (we saw a small uptick recently).
HyperGate_Rep: Understood — proposing: expedite EUR 8,000 + broker EUR 600 per AWB + crossdock EUR 400 per pallet. DOA coverage: yes for verified DOA within 30 days, courier cost borne by us.
Shawn Patel: Requesting negotiation: we cover broker + crossdock, vendor covers expedite 50%. Ops: estimate customer SLO hit if no partial release: Dedicated capacity shortfall ~18k token/s-hours -> revenue impact.
Marco Ruiz: I'll run the SLO impact calc. Can vendor provide photographic evidence of hold and customs correspondence? Need trail for finance.
HyperGate_Rep: attaching docs now: https://hypergate.com/awbdocs/3344556677 (sent)
VendorOpsBot: doc_upload: 3344556677_manifest.pdf ok
Lina Gomez: Ops decision: We'll accept 8 units via air from HyperGate, vendor to cover 50% expedite; we move 6 from eu-west-2 to eu-west-1 for warm spares staggered; finance to approve vendor credit request.
Anita Chen: Confirmed. @Finance please review vendor credit note and create PO for partial expedite. Also set RMA flag 'wave42-partial' so replacements created if DOA.
Shawn Patel: Note for oncall — monitor cluster temps during rollout; set auto-fallback to smaller batch size in serving runtime if latency spikes.
Marco Ruiz: Thanks everyone. HyperGate, please send final invoice and signed partial-acceptance when available.
HyperGate_Rep: Will send within 2h. Thanks.
